sections.label: Merdeka Generation benefits and subsidies
sections.summary: From July, MG seniors can redeem $100 PAssion Silver top-ups and receive MediSave top-ups, MediShield Life subsidies, CHAS subsidies and a CareShield Life incentive.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: From July this year, MG seniors can redeem their $100 PAssion Silver card top-ups at selected Community Clubs (CCs), Mass Rapid Transit stations and bus interchanges.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: They can use these credits to pay for activities at their CCs, entry to ActiveSG pools and gyms, public transport and more.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: They will also receive their first MediSave top-ups in July, as well as additional subsidies for their MediShield Life premiums.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: From November onwards, they will enjoy subsidies for their bills at Community Health Assist Scheme (CHAS) clinics, polyclinics and Specialist Outpatient Clinics.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: In addition, they can enjoy a $4,000 sign-up incentive if they join CareShield Life between 2021 and 2023.

sections.label: Fund amount and projected costs
sections.summary: The Government will set aside $6.1 billion in the Fund, which with interest is estimated to cover the Package's projected cost of over $8 billion.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: As mentioned in this year's Budget, the Government will set aside $6.1 billion in this Fund.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: With accumulated interest over time, we estimate that this amount will be sufficient to cover the projected cost of the Package, which is over $8 billion.

sections.label: MGP birth year eligibility
sections.summary: The MGP applies to Singapore Citizens born between 1 January 1950 and 31 December 1959.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
